# Reminder

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Reminder`](gmeow-Reminder.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Reminder>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/calendar`](../../slices/calendar.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A reminder associated with an event — a trigger (offset or absolute time) and an action (display, email, audio).

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to model an iCalendar VALARM attached to an event — a trigger (an offset before it or an absolute time) plus an action to fire.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the event's own temporal placement (that is on the event) and for a task's due date (use [`gmeow:taskDueDate`](../properties/gmeow-taskDueDate.md)); a reminder is an alert about a target, not the target's schedule.

### How to use

- Bind it to its [`gmeow:reminderTarget`](../properties/gmeow-reminderTarget.md) event, set a [`gmeow:reminderTrigger`](../properties/gmeow-reminderTrigger.md) ([xsd:duration](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#duration) offset or absolute [xsd:dateTime](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime)), and choose a [`gmeow:reminderAction`](../properties/gmeow-reminderAction.md).

### Examples

- ex:standupAlarm a [`gmeow:Reminder`](gmeow-Reminder.md); [`gmeow:reminderTarget`](../properties/gmeow-reminderTarget.md) ex:standupEvent; [`gmeow:reminderTrigger`](../properties/gmeow-reminderTrigger.md) "PT15M"^^[xsd:duration](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#duration); [`gmeow:reminderAction`](../properties/gmeow-reminderAction.md) [`gmeow:reminderActionDisplay`](../individuals/gmeow-reminderActionDisplay.md).
